t: Report Re Anonymous Letter Addressed To The Political Department S.M.P., Date 151130

pages.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
REPORT
File No.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
Special Branch No. - 1 SERIES,
No. S. B. D. 2108.
Date November 17, 1930.
6 - 3 - 31.
Subject (in full) Anonymous letter addressed to the Political Department,
S.M.P., dated 15/11/30.
Made by D. I. Robertson Forwarded by
Inquiries made by Chinese detectives attached
to S. 1 in cooperation with Chinese detectives attached
to Louza Station go to show that at 7 p.m. on November
16 a Chinese named Van Ah Too (萬阿多) alias Yu-hsiang
gave a dinner to some 30 relatives and friends on the
occasion of his 50th birthday, at the Yoeh Ping Lur
Restaurant, 289 Hupeh Road. No politics of any
kind were discussed at the dinner.
Van Ah Too (萬阿多), alias Yu-hsiang, is a
native of Pootung and resides at 2588 Haining Road.
For the past ten years he has been employed as an
inspector at the Yung Foong Silk Filature, Kansuh Road,
and is reputed to be a respectable citizen.
CCP
Henry Robertson
D. I.
D. C. (Cr. & Sp. Branches).
Reg.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
报告
档案号
上海公共租界工部局警务处
特务科第 - 1 系列，
编号 S. B. D. 2108。
日期 1930年11月17日。
6 - 3 - 31。
主题（全称）致工部局警务处政治部的匿名信，日期为1930年11月15日。
由 D. I. Robertson 提交 转交人
经隶属于 S. 1 的华籍侦探与隶属于老闸捕房的华籍侦探合作调查，结果显示：11月16日晚7时，一名名为 Van Ah Too（萬阿多）、别名 Yu-hsiang 的华人在湖北路289号悦平楼餐馆举办晚宴，宴请约30名亲友，庆祝其五十寿辰。晚宴期间未讨论任何政治议题。
Van Ah Too（萬阿多），别名 Yu-hsiang，系浦东人，居住在海宁路2588号。过去十年间，他受雇于甘肃路永丰丝厂担任稽查员， reputed to be a respectable citizen（被视为正派市民）。
中共
Henry Robertson
督察长
副总监（刑事及特务科）。
登记
请归档
副本
11月17日

pages.en:
Translation of an anonymous letter addressed to the
Political Department of the S.M.P., dated 15/11/30.
------------------

Van Ah Too (萬阿土), alias Yu Ziang (裕祥),
is an important Communist leader in Shanghai. He
will give a dinner to members of the Communist Party
in the Yoeh Ping Lur (悅平樓) Restuarant, 289 Hupeh
Road, between 7 and 8 p.m. November 16, at which
measures to create disturbances locally will be discussed.
Please give an order that he be arrested and severely
punished.
pages.zh:
致工部局警务处政治部的匿名信译文，日期为1930年11月15日。
------------------

Van Ah Too（萬阿土），别名 Yu Ziang（裕祥），是上海的一名重要共产党领导人。他将于11月16日晚7时至8时，在湖北路289号悦平楼（Yoeh Ping Lur）餐馆宴请共产党员，届时将讨论在当地制造骚乱的措施。
请下令将其逮捕并严惩。
